import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the seed dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/Users/bytedance/Desktop/bench/seed_datasets/ecommerce/orders.csv')

# Rename columns for semantic obfuscation
column_mapping = {
    'order_id': 'transaction_id',
    'customer_id': 'client_id',
    'order_date': 'date_of_purchase',
    'category': 'product_category',
    'unit_price': 'price_per_unit',
    'quantity': 'items_sold',
    'total_amount': 'revenue',
    'channel': 'purchase_channel',
    'returned': 'is_returned',
    'rating': 'customer_rating'
}
df.rename(columns=column_mapping, inplace=True)

# Inject a canary value into the 'revenue' column
np.random.seed(42)
canary_index = np.random.choice(df.index, size=1)
df.loc[canary_index, 'revenue'] = -99999

# Select a random subset of columns
selected_columns = ['date_of_purchase', 'revenue', 'product_category']
df_subset = df[selected_columns]

# Save the modified dataset as 'dataset.csv'
df_subset.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
